evidence.text: Pair-difference mapmaking combines polynomial and scan-synchronous filtering with temperature-template deprojection. sources.title: Joint Analysis of BICEP2/$Keck  Array$ and $Planck$ Data

evidence.text: Planck maps are resmoothed to the BICEP2/Keck beam and passed through its observing/filtering matrix before comparison. Matrix-based purification suppresses E-to-B mixing; Planck single-frequency spectra use independent data-split cross-spectra.

sources.title: Improved Constraints on Cosmology and Foregrounds from BICEP2 and Keck Array Cosmic Microwave Background Data with Inclusion of 95 GHz Band

evidence.text: Map processing includes detector-pair differencing, atmospheric and scan-synchronous filtering, and deprojection of temperature-to-polarization beam leakage. External maps are beam-matched and passed through the observing matrix. Separate matrix purification operators suppress E-to-B mixing for the two BK bands.

sources.title: Improved Constraints on Primordial Gravitational Waves using Planck, WMAP, and BICEP/Keck Observations through the 2018 Observing Season

evidence.text: Polarized detector-pair timestreams form Q/U maps. Matrix purification suppresses E-to-B leakage; inverse-noise apodization, Fourier transformation and rotation to E/B yield angular spectra. Different sky masks are incorporated in bandpower window functions.

sources.title: Detection of $B$-Mode Polarization at Degree Angular Scales by BICEP2

evidence.text: Uses time-stream signal simulations, sign-flipped data noise pseudosimulations, noise debiasing, and simulated band-power windows. Tensor amplitudes use simulation-based direct likelihoods; the frequency-index analysis uses a joint Hamimeche–Lewis likelihood with band-power marginalization.

sources.title: Detection of $B$-Mode Polarization at Degree Angular Scales by BICEP2

evidence.text: Matrix purification models filtering by m̃ = Rm, propagates E/B covariances as RCRᵀ, and selects large-eigenvalue solutions of a regularized generalized eigenproblem. The resulting projector removes E/B-ambiguous modes before spectrum estimation.
